summary: MKDWELL Tech Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Landvision Inc. on August 7, 2026, following a sale and purchase agreement referenced in a prior July 17, 2026 filing. The consideration was 30,000,000 newly issued ordinary shares, representing approximately 87.72% of the enlarged share capital. Post-transaction, MKDWELL has 34,198,442 ordinary shares, 274,366 Class A preferred shares, and 6,036,875 warrants outstanding. No financial terms, advisors, or regulatory details were disclosed. Watch for potential dilution effects and integration progress.
